sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_flows AS (SELECT * FROM signals.fii_dii_flows WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'),
      latest_regime AS (SELECT * FROM signals.regime_history WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'),
      latest_breadth AS (SELECT * FROM breadth.market_daily WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'),
      latest_index AS (SELECT * FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months')
SELECT f.trade_date, r.regime, f.flow_signal, b.ad_signal, i.trend_signal
FROM latest_flows f
JOIN latest_regime r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN latest_breadth b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN latest_index i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
WHERE i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
ORDER BY f.trade_date DESC;
